decode_emissions_with_ctc_greedy: create a CTCGreedyDecoder and call decode with emission probabilities and timestamps to get decoded label sequences
decode_emissions_with_ctc_beam: create a CTCBeamDecoder with a KenLM model path and beam size, then decode emission probabilities to get label sequences
decode_batch_emissions: use the decode_batch method on a Decoder instance to offline decode a batch of emission matrices with varying lengths
compute_logsumexp: call logsumexp with multiple log-space probability values to stably sum them without numerical overflow
get_best_beam_decodings: call get_best_decodings on a CTCBeamDecoder to retrieve the top k decoded label sequences and their timestamps
